description: Elections Commission - Declare that the names of the Members elected for Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content contains the official declaration of election results for a Local Authority (Elepitiya Pradeshiya Sabha), including the names of elected members for each ward and members returned for the authority. It is published by the Election Commission under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, which falls squarely under electoral processes and results declarations, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
